comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Shell integration now exists (round 3, a_2XJ1hMByY), so OSC 133 prompt marks reach the daemon's terminal; what remains is the C API for at-prompt state and eraseActive.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: Ghostty's clear_screen binding, with shell integration on, erases the screen and scrollback but keeps the prompt, and asks the shell to redraw. muster-daemon defers it (round 2, slot 2) because it needs OSC 133 at-prompt state and Ghostty's eraseActive, neither of which libghostty-vt's C API exposes. Likely a small addition to deps/ghostty-patches (C API only, never upstreamed), after the pane environment card (a_2XJ1hMByY) lands shell integration.
title: muster-daemon: honor clear_screen with shell integration
